name: Peru coastal El Niño (extraordinary)
headline: Kelvin waves reaching South America keep warm water against the coast.

sections.The setup: ENFEN alert (16 Sep): coastal El Niño of extraordinary magnitude likely; coastal sea 5–8 °C above normal.
sections.The trigger: Kelvin waves reaching South America keep warm water against the coast.
sections.What amplified it: Anchovy season ended at 25% of quota; early heavy rain in Tumbes and Piura; heaviest rain expected Feb–Mar 2027.
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
